unresolved.finding: nf90_inquire_dimension copies uninitialized local outputs when nf_inq_dim fails, without checking its returned status.
Every EightByteInt put wrapper converts values to default INTEGER before netCDF sees them, allowing out-of-range 64-bit values to be corrupted without a netCDF range error.
EightByteInt get wrappers read through default-INTEGER temporaries, preventing retrieval of otherwise representable 64-bit integer results from wider numeric variables.
Optional start/count/stride/map vectors are copied into fixed-size local arrays without checking their lengths against nf90_max_var_dims.
Integer array getters reshape the entire uninitialized temporary after partial, sparse, zero-count, or failed reads, evaluating elements the underlying call did not populate.
Scalar integer getters assign defaultInteger to values even when the underlying read fails without defining the temporary.
Caller-supplied count and map are forwarded without checking that their memory footprint fits values or defaultIntArray, permitting out-of-bounds transfers for inconsistent selections.
localMap is initialized only through the memory-array rank, leaving trailing map entries undefined when a shorter supplied map is used with a higher-rank file variable.
Default map strides are calculated with default-INTEGER products that can overflow for large multidimensional arrays.
The multiprocess create/open wrappers declare chunk-size hints INTENT(IN) although the corresponding ordinary wrappers treat these underlying library arguments as writable INOUT values.
nf90_inquire copies local inquiry outputs without checking success and overwrites the first status with nf_inq_format when formatNum is requested.
Scalar text get/put accepts map but never uses it or rejects it, silently performing an unmapped strided transfer.
Scalar text put always passes trim(values), so an explicit count including trailing blanks can request more characters than the temporary contains.
Optional indexing vectors are copied into fixed-size arrays without validating their lengths.
Array text wrappers initialize only numDims map entries although character storage needs numDims+1, leaving the last active stride undefined when the supplied map is shorter.
Array text wrappers default trailing file-dimension counts to zero instead of one, so selecting a record of a higher-rank variable using start alone can transfer no data.
Array text wrappers pass only the first scalar element of an assumed-shape array to bulk I/O, without packing or requiring contiguous actual arrays.
Array text wrappers form the first-element actual argument even for empty arrays, before a zero transfer count can neutralize the lower-level operation.
Explicit count and map selections are forwarded without checking whether the requested character footprint fits the supplied string or array.
Default character map strides use default-INTEGER products that can overflow for large string arrays.
byteSizesOK never checks EightByteInt availability or bit size despite claiming to validate the module's selected integer kinds.
The root's interactive READ has no IOSTAT, END, or ERR handling, so EOF or malformed input terminates it while other ranks are entering MPI_BCAST.
Negative interval counts enter the calculation branch and print a zero approximation instead of being rejected or treated as quit.
An accepted interval count near INT_MAX can overflow the signed loop increment i += numprocs.
The API returns pointers to communicator ID records without documenting whether subsequent additions, synchronization, or merging invalidate them.
CLOG_MAXTIME is asserted to be later than all times although its finite value requires an undocumented bound and time origin.
CLOG_Pint is defined as 32-bit despite being described as address-sized in this x64 header, risking truncation in attribute pointer conversions.
i32fmt uses %ld for CLOG_int32_t defined as __int32, leaving an int-versus-long variadic type mismatch even where both types occupy four bytes.
CLOG_UUID_SIZE expands to an unparenthesized sum, so expressions such as 2 * CLOG_UUID_SIZE compute an incorrect size.
MPEU_DLL_SPEC is defined for Windows import/export but is never applied to any logging declaration in this header.
Event logging accepts an unbounded const char pointer without specifying whether it must reference MPE_LOG_BYTESIZE bytes or may be null.
MPE_Errors_to_dbx is declared after the extern C block closes, giving C++ callers C++ linkage for an apparent C library callback.
The feature list defines MPIIMPL_HAVE_MPI_TYPE_CREATE_DARRAY twice and omits the corresponding TYPE_CREATE_SUBARRAY advertisement beside COMBINER_SUBARRAY.
MPIX and PMPIX generalized-request extension declarations occur outside extern C, causing C++ callers to request C++ linkage for the C extension functions.
NULL_COPY_FN sets flag=true without defining attr_out, reporting a successful attribute copy with an indeterminate output pointer.
Cartcomm::Sub always reads ten booleans and allocates ten integers regardless of topology dimension, overreading smaller input arrays and undersizing larger topologies.
Alltoallw sizes and fills datatype temporaries using local Get_size rather than remote size, producing out-of-bounds accesses for unequal intercommunicator groups.
Alltoallw dereferences send datatype entries even for an in-place call whose send-side arguments are ignored by the underlying collective.
Datatype::Get_contents copies max_datatypes entries from its temporary rather than the actual datatype count, reading an uninitialized tail when capacity exceeds the envelope count.
Waitsome and Testsome copy every temporary status instead of only the returned completion count, including undefined entries when no requests complete or all are inactive.
Testall copies its uninitialized status temporary even when the returned completion flag is false.
Cartcomm::Get_topo converts maxdims temporary entries to bool instead of the actual dimension count, reading an uninitialized tail for oversized output capacity.
Raw temporary allocations lack exception cleanup, and throwing error handlers skip both deallocation and request/status copyback after MPI has potentially changed them.
Scalar getters return uninitialized local outputs if the underlying MPI operation fails and the invoked error handler returns normally.
Clone implementations ignore MPI_Comm_dup status and construct a wrapper from uninitialized ncomm when duplication fails with a returning handler.
Spawn_multiple allocates from count and dereferences array_of_info on every rank although these inputs are significant only at root.
Grequest::Start is declared as an instance member rather than a static factory, preventing the expected MPI::Grequest::Start invocation without an object.
The header has no include guard and leaves MPIR_ARGUNUSED defined despite promising its removal, so a repeated direct include triggers an error and redefinitions.
DLLIMPORT annotations cover every sentinel COMMON block except MPIFCMB6 containing MPI_ERRCODES_IGNORE, leaving that sentinel's DLL address identity inconsistent.
MPIO_Request aliases MPI_Request but MPIO_REQUEST_NULL remains zero instead of the nonzero MPI_REQUEST_NULL handle.
Including mpio.h first in C++ loads mpi.h and its C++ bindings before MPI_MODE_RDONLY and I/O declarations exist, causing the guarded MPI::File methods to be omitted.
Nonblocking-I/O comments claim generalized requests are unimplemented although this header explicitly enables them and aliases MPIO requests to MPI requests.
O:FH mode omits src[f] even though its stated output contract includes the source file prerequisite.
The suffix regex begins with an unescaped dot and removes the entire name for a dotless source path, collapsing its object target to prefix plus suffix.
Whitespace tokenization recognizes only bare USE followed immediately by the module name, missing USE-qualified forms and misparsing USE :: module.
Module-provider detection excludes only MODULE PROCEDURE, so MODULE FUNCTION and MODULE SUBROUTINE are incorrectly registered as modules named function and subroutine.
Include detection is case-sensitive and recognizes neither uppercase Fortran INCLUDE nor preprocessor #include directives.
Included files are recorded but never scanned, so module USE dependencies and nested includes inside them are absent from the generated build graph.
Unreadable source files are silently skipped on IOError, allowing an incomplete dependency graph to be emitted successfully.
A second provider of the same module silently overwrites the first, making dependency resolution depend on input order.
Source and include paths are whitespace-tokenized or emitted without make escaping, so paths containing spaces or make metacharacters produce incorrect rules.
MS_WIN64 is derived from _WIN64 only inside the MSVC branch, so a 64-bit GNU Windows build falls through to four-byte pointer and size_t definitions.
Py_IS_INFINITY evaluates its argument twice on the non-finite path, producing inconsistent results or duplicate side effects for expressions such as function calls.
The Windows configuration advertises Unix-style libnsl and libsocket availability without a compiler or platform guard.
The long description calls XBeach public-domain while the classifier and license fields declare GPLv3, leaving the distribution's licensing description contradictory.
nose and teamcity-nose are mandatory installation dependencies even though the latter is explicitly identified as a CI requirement.
